dataset.source: UCI Machine Learning Repository (Moro et al., 2014)
dataset.anti_leakage_note: Call duration is strictly excluded because it is only known after marketing contact, preventing data leakage and unrealistic performance claims.

statistical_verdict: The 95% confidence intervals for Decision Tree Classifier [0.4468, 0.5011] and Random Forest Classifier [0.4464, 0.4965] overlap. Their performances are not statistically distinguishable on this test set.

best_overall_model.selection_rationale: Designated as production standard due to highest discriminative capacity (ROC-AUC 0.7986), highest sensitivity (Recall 50.0%), and lowest Brier score (0.0822), while its F1-score (0.4732) is statistically indistinguishable from Decision Tree (0.4751) under 95% bootstrap confidence intervals.

literature_review.title: Banking in Terms of Deposit Prediction Based on Machine Learning and Big Data Analytics
literature_review.authors: Nourah Alessa, Amal Majdua, Sharifah Alshehri, Maryam Alhawiti, Resan Aljohani, A'aeshah Alhakamy
literature_review.venue: IEEE 11th International Conference on Control, Mechatronics and Automation (ICCMA)
literature_review.models: Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, KNN, Random Forest, SVM + PySpark
literature_review.findings: Ensemble bagging models (Random Forest) consistently surpassed individual linear classifiers in complex demographic interactions, especially when integrated with big data processing.

literature_review.title: Enhancing Marketing Strategies: Analyzing Customer Behavior in Banking through Data Analysis and Machine Learning
literature_review.authors: Davinder Paul Singh, Mani Manjari, Dipti Jain, S. B. Uppal, R. Kumar, P. Goel
literature_review.venue: IEEE Trends in Information and Advanced Computing (TIACOMP)
literature_review.models: Random Forest, Decision Tree, Logistic Regression with SMOTE
literature_review.findings: Addressing severe class imbalance significantly boosted subscription recall from ~30% to over 70%, preventing minority class starvation.

literature_review.title: Innovative Approaches of Machine Learning to Enhance Predictive Analytics Based on Banking Institution Strategies
literature_review.venue: IEEE 3rd International Conference for Advancement in Technology (ICONAT)
literature_review.models: KNN, Logistic Regression, Gaussian NB, Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost, Stacking
literature_review.findings: Achieved peak prediction accuracy through rigorous preprocessing, feature scaling, and ensemble stacking over standalone classifiers.

literature_review.title: Bayesian Regression for Predicting Subscription to Bank Term Deposits in Direct Marketing Campaigns

literature_review.models: Bayesian Logistic Regression, Probit Regression, Logit
